sentences.en: Mali is one of the poorest countries in Subsaharan Africa.
sentences.zh: 马里是撒哈拉以南非洲最贫穷的国家之一。

sentences.en: My friend may have had a bad time in Africa.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友在非洲可能遇到了一些不愉快的事情。

sentences.en: The Zulu tribe in South Africa has its own language.
sentences.zh: 南非的祖鲁部落有自己的语言。
